name: Sekisui Jushi Corporation
summary: Sekisui Jushi Corporation provides various products and services through the application of composite technology in Japan. The company offers soundproofing materials; traffic safety products; electronic system-related products; road marking materials; road signs; and pedestrian and vehicle guardrails, snow and windbreak fences, wheel stops, prefabricated walkways, railings, park materials, shelters, solar lighting, artificial wood, etc. It also provides artificial turf, artificial turf field watering system, artificial turf field high-speed drainage system, temporary traffic safety products, heat-shielding pavement, concrete spalling prevention systems, signs, billboards, etc. In addition, t…
